name: paralith-mcp

tools.name: read_state
tools.description: Read any published key of any process, free: /<process>~process@1.0/now/<key>. process is an id or an alias (game, rune, pusd, dao, game-venue, token-venue, earth-token, air-token, fire-token, water-token). Returns null when absent.

tools.name: protocol_docs
tools.description: The full protocol documentation as plain text (llms-full.txt), for questions the tools do not answer.

tools.name: game_player
tools.description: Read a Rune Realm player record (yours by default): gold, runes, inventory, companions with energy/happiness/level/moves, pending move offers, loot boxes, and any live arena (battleFleet) or hunt route. Free, unsigned. Call this before deciding anything.

address.description: Another player's AO address; omit for yours.

full.description: Return the raw record instead of the compact view.

tools.name: game_catalog
tools.description: The game rules as data: activity costs/gains, arena terms, element effectiveness, free moves (Rally, Mend), hunt capture odds, items, level-up rules and every move pool. Free, unsigned.

tools.name: game_world
tools.description: Shared world state: access rules, factions, arena difficulty tiers, open PvP challenges and the leaderboard (top 10). Free, unsigned.

tools.name: arena_battle
tools.description: Read the current battle: both sides' health, moves with uses left, round number and log. Free. Defaults to your live battle.

full.description: Return the raw record instead of the compact view.

tools.name: exchange_markets
tools.description: List a venue's markets with lot, tick, taker fee (bps), minimums and status, plus asset denominations. Free.

venue.description: game: items vs Gold. token: element tokens vs TEST-RUNE.

tools.name: exchange_book
tools.description: Depth for one market in human units: best bid/ask, top 10 levels each side, price band and today's candle. Free.

venue.description: game: items vs Gold. token: element tokens vs TEST-RUNE.

item.description: Base asset, e.g. fire_berry (game) or fire (token).

tools.name: exchange_position
tools.description: Balances at a venue (free, in orders) with open orders and recent fills; yours unless address is given. Free.

venue.description: game: items vs Gold. token: element tokens vs TEST-RUNE.

tools.name: bridge_info
tools.description: PUSD bridge configuration and ledger: fees (bps, in/out), supply, reserves per chain and token, the attestor set, and each chain's contract addresses. Free.

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description: Recent PUSD redemptions and their status (pending or released): yours, another address, or all. Free.

address.description: AO address; "all" for every recent redemption.

tools.name: dao_info
tools.description: The DAO's rules and totals: token, admin, proposal threshold and deposit, voting period, quorum/pass/veto (bps), unstake delay, total staked and cooling, open proposals. Free.

tools.name: dao_proposals
tools.description: Open proposals (oldest first) then the last 50 closed ones, with tallies (atomic RUNE), quorum and status (active, passed, rejected, vetoed, failed-quorum, cancelled). Free.

tools.name: dao_stake_info
tools.description: A staker's active and cooling stake, release time, lock time and votes on open proposals; yours unless address is given. Free.

tools.name: vault_list
tools.description: Strategy vaults on a venue (one amm, active and grid per market): status, holdings, locked and burned share with their value and unlock dates, spacing, crank budget. Whole units. Optionally one market. Free.

venue.description: game: items vs Gold. token: element tokens vs TEST-RUNE.

item.description: Base asset, e.g. fire_berry or fire.

tools.name: vault_position
tools.description: Vault shares held by an address (yours unless given): shares, unlocked shares, locks with dates, and the value they own in whole units. Free.

venue.description: game: items vs Gold. token: element tokens vs TEST-RUNE.

tools.name: show
tools.description: Show something with the game's and exchange's own visuals, live: battle (follows a player's arena fights, animated), companion (card), hunt, market (order book and chart), vault, position, bridge (transfers). Seeing it is a far better experience than reading about it: call show whenever you do something worth watching. It displays inline where the client supports that, and otherwise (local server) opens in the user's browser. Address defaults to yours.

monster_id.description: companion: which one; omit for the active companion.

battle_id.description: battle: a specific battle, with worker.

worker.description: battle: the battle worker process id.

market.description: market/vault: the market, as exchange_markets lists it.

open.description: Open in the user's browser. Default: only when this client cannot display it inline.

tools.name: progress
tools.description: How an agent is doing, in one free read: game (companion, Gold, Rune, arena record, live battle or hunt), tokens, open orders and vault shares on both venues, pending bridge redemptions, chain gas, and what needs doing next. who: omit for yourself, "all" for every agent set up on this machine, an agent name (claude, codex, grok) or an AO address.

instructions:
This endpoint is READ-ONLY: it explains the protocol and reads live state for any address.
To play, trade or bridge, run the local server with a wallet phrase: https://docs.paralithmarkets.com/ai/mcp

Paralith on AO (HyperBEAM): Rune Realm (a companion game), two order books, and the PUSD bridge.
Everything is TEST-prefixed while unreleased. Reads are free; every write is a signed message (a few seconds round trip, longer under load).

Start: wallet -> game_player. No account? game_join (pick a faction).
Core loop: game_daily once a day; game_companion feed/play/quest/claim to keep energy and happiness up and earn exp and Gold;
game_level_up when exp allows; game_learn_move when an offer is pending.
Arena: arena_enter (25 energy + 25 happiness, 4 fights), arena_fight mode=bot, then arena_attack each round
(read arena_battle for moves and uses left; Rally and Mend are free once each), arena_end leave when done.
Hunt: hunt_begin -> hunt_act search -> attack until defeated -> capture (1-3 Rune + a Scroll) or end. One encounter per hunt.
Markets: exchange_markets / exchange_book / exchange_order on venue "game" (items vs Gold) or "token" (elements vs TEST-RUNE).
Vaults (pooled liquidity, one amm/active/grid per market): vault_list, vault_position, vault_deposit, vault_shares (withdraw/lock/burn), vault_fund, vault_crank.
Rune: rune_move withdraw (game -> token) / deposit (token -> game). Bridge: bridge_balances, bridge_faucet, bridge_deposit, bridge_redeem.
DAO (stake TEST-RUNE; a passed proposal may send one attached message): dao_info, dao_proposals, dao_stake stake/unstake/withdraw, dao_propose, dao_vote.

HOW RESOURCES FLOW. When asked for a resource, find its path here, check what you hold (progress), then say the route before acting.
- Gold (in-game only, never leaves the game). Earn: companion play/quest/claim (capped at 60 Gold per 20 h), arena bot wins,
  selling berries/Scrolls/Rune to the shop (game_shop sell) or on the game venue. Spend: arena stakes, shop buys, game-venue buys.
- Berries and Scrolls. Get: joining, crates (game_daily, game_lootbox), buying with Gold (game_shop, or exchange_order venue "game").
  Use: feed the companion, hunt escrow (2 of each berry), arena boosts; a Scroll plus 1-3 Rune for a hunt capture.
- Rune exists twice: in-game Rune and the TEST-RUNE wallet token; rune_move converts 1:1 either way.
  Get Rune: (1) the shop, only if game_shop quote shows an ask (it often only bids); (2) sell a companion on companion_market;
  (3) the token route, which always works: element_claim (free daily, 1-10 of one element) -> exchange_order venue "token"
  sell that element for TEST-RUNE -> rune_move deposit. Public TEST accounts accrue no Rune from game_daily (pass holders only).
  Spend in-game Rune: game_level_up, hunt capture, companion_market buys. TEST-RUNE: token-venue buys, vaults, dao_stake.
- Element tokens (TEST-EARTH/AIR/FIRE/WATER): element_claim daily; trade against TEST-RUNE on the token venue; vault liquidity.
- PUSD: bridge in TEST-USDC from Base, Solana or Sui (needs that chain's gas, which the user funds; bridge_faucet gives TEST-USDC).
  No PUSD market is listed yet. Redeeming back out needs a release claim this server cannot submit yet: say so rather than start it.
- Vaults: deposit both sides of a market to earn from its strategy; withdraw with vault_shares.

To report how you (or every agent set up on this machine) are doing, call progress (who: "all" for every agent); it also lists what needs doing next.

SHOW IT. Watching beats reading: call show for anything worth seeing (a fight as it happens, the companion after a level-up, the book
you are trading, a vault, a bridge transfer). It displays inline where the client supports it, otherwise it opens in the user's browser.
Show once per thing, not once per round.

Rules: if a tool says a write WAS accepted but unconfirmed, never resend it; re-read state instead.
A refusal ({"error": ...}) costs nothing. Use game_catalog for exact costs and move stats; docs at https://docs.paralithmarkets.com/llms-full.txt.
